mission.title: Umsebenzi
mission.description: I-NetComplex ayisosicibuko sokulawula. Liphatifom elenzelwe ukudibanisa abamelwane, ukulungelelanisa imisebenzi yomphakathi, nokuphucula ikhwalithi yobomi ezinhlakeni zokuhlala. Sikholwa ukuba umphakathi oxhunyiwe ngempela uyamemelisa abahlali, ulula ukulawula, futhi udala ubudlelwano obuhlala ihora.
mission.coreBelief: Umzila awusoyedwa wumuntu nje — kuwukuhlalisana okuphilayo kwabantu, ubudlelwano, namava ababelwanayo. Sakha i-NetComplex ukuqinisa lezi nxiba ngokuhlakanipha koyilo neteknoloji engenalutho.

features.title: Akha Umphakathi Oxhunyiwe
features.subtitle: Izinsiza ezinamandla eziguqula izindlu zokuhlala zibe umphakathi owaziwayo, obandakanyekayo, nokusonta izwi.

list.title: Uhlu Lwabahlali
list.desc: Yazi abamelwane bakho kunye nohlu olupheleleyo.
list.details: Yenza iphrofayela yakho ngefoto, izinto ozithandayo, namathuba. Khangela ngensimu noma isigaba. Izilawuli zokuvikela ziqinisekisa ukuthi wabelana ngalutho owufuna nje.

list.title: Izicelo Zokugcina
list.desc: Loga, sika, silungise. Kusukela emathongeni avuzayo kuya ezigcwaningweni zomphakathi.
list.details: Thumela iifoto nezincazelo. Qhubeka nokuthuthukiswa kwezimo ngesikhathi sangempela. Xhumana ngqo nabasebenzi bokugcina. Hlola ikhwalithi yenkonzo nexesha lokusombulula.

list.title: Ukubhukisha Izindawo
list.desc: Bhukisha izinzuzo ngokulula. Amapulazi eswimi, izindlu zokungena, amacourt.
list.details: Bheka ukuthi kungathengiswa ngesikhathi sangempela. Lungisa amabhukishingi aphindiweyo. Fumana izikhumbuzi ezizenzekelayo. Suswa noma uguqule ngokulula. Ukuhlanganiswa kwekhelenda.

list.title: Okunikazi Komphakathi
list.desc: indawo yakho yokuthumela izindaba, amabali, nezaziso.
list.details: Umhleli wombhalo onamandla aneefoto namavidiyo. Hlukanisa okunikazi ukuthi lutholakale ngokulula. Commenta uze usabele ezindabeni. Lawula ngemithetho yomphakathi.

list.title: Uphengululo Namaphulo
list.desc: Buza umphakathi wakho. Fumana iimpendulo ezisebenzayo. Imibuzo ekhawulezayo, imvakalelo ekhawulezayo.
list.details: Yenza imibuzo enezinketho ezininzi, ukulinganisa, nemibuzo evulekileyo. Iimpendulo ezingabikho noma ezibiziweyo. Ukubonakaliswa kwemiphumo ngesikhathi sangempela. Khuphela idatha ukuze uhlaziywe.

list.title: Amagatsha Obuhlobo
list.desc: Thola abantu bakho ngaphakathi kwekompleks yakho. Xhumana ngezinhlobo zokufuna.
list.details: Yenza uze ujoyine amagatsha angenxa zokufuna. Amasethingi eprivate noma awavulelekile. Ukucwangciswa kwezinto ngaphakathi kwama-gatsha. Uhlu lwamalungu nemiyalezo.

list.title: Izinto Zomphakathi
list.desc: Thola futhi ulungele izinto ezisondeza umphakathi wakho.
list.details: Yenza izinto ne-RSVP tracking. Thumela izikhumbuzi ezizenzekelayo. Thengisa amitiketi noma collect fees. Ukwabelana ngefoto emva kwezinto. Amashedi wezinto eziphindayo.

list.title: I-Web3 Digital Identity
list.desc: Akha ulawulo lomphakathi olusikelwe kwindawo nephasiphodi yedijithali.
list.details: Inkqubo zokuvota ezisekelwe kuitokeni. Ulawulo lwentlawulo yomphakathi. Ama-NFT membership. Uqinisekiso lobunikazi obusikelwe kwindawo. Ukuzenzekelayo kwe-smart contract.

list.title: Ukuhlaziywa Kolwimi
list.details: Guqulela okunikazi, izaziso, ne-interface kwiilwimi ezininzi ngokuzenzekelayo.

list.title: I-Agent Gateway
list.desc: Dibanisa abantu nam agents emishini kwiinkqubo zomphakathi.
list.details: Xhumana, Inkxaso elawulwayo, Inkxaso eqhubezekayo ye-AI. Ukuhlaziywa kwezicelo zokugcina ngokuzenzekelayo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwekhaya le-smart. Usizo olusekelwe ilizwi.

list.title: Imarketplace
list.desc: Thenga futhi uthengise izimpahla nemisebenzi kuluntu lwakho.
list.details: Imarketplace yendawo yabahlali. Ukucubungula yezimali okhuselekileyo. Inkqubo yovavanyo nokunikela amakhadi. Imiyalezo elula phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi.

list.title: Imfundo
list.details: I-Portal yama-Bursary, ama-course online namavidiyo. Izinto zokufunda zomphakathi. Ukwabelana ngezinsiza. Ukufunda ngabalingane. Ilayibrari yomxholo wezemfundo.

about.title: Nge-NetComplex
about.subtitle: Iphatifomu yolwazi lomphakathi eyakhelwe ukuxhuma abamelwane, ukwenza imisebenzi ibe lula, nokuthuthukisa impilo ezindaweni zokuhlala.
about.storyP1: I-NetComplex yazalwa ngokubona okulula: imiphakathi yokuhlala yayiphethwe ngama-spreadsheet, izaziso zama-imeyili, namathuluzi ezokuxhumana angadidiyelanga. Abahlali babengenayo indawo emaphakathi yokuxhuma, yokuxhumana, noma yokusebenzisana.
about.storyP2: Sayakha i-NetComplex ukushintsha lokho. Okwaqala njengesixazululo somphakathi owodwa eKapa sekukhule kwaba yipulatiformu esebenzela izinxibo zokuhlala zabo bonke osayizi kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni.
about.storyP3: Namuhla, i-NetComplex inika amandla imiphakathi ngamathuluzi okuxhumana, ukunakekelwa, ukubhukha, imicimbi, nokubusa — konke endaweni eyodwa. Sisemsebenzini wokwenza yonke ikhompleksi ibe ngumphakathi oxhunyiwe.
about.value1Desc: Yonke into esiyakhayo iqala ngombuzo ofanayo: ingabe lokhu kuyawahlomisa amakhaya, kuyawakhulula abamelwane bakho, futhi kuyawahlanganisa umphakathi?
about.value2Desc: Amathuluzi anamandla akudingeki abe yinkimbinkimbi. Siqamba ngokucacileyo nangokuphendula ukuze wonke umhlali akwazi ukubamba iqhaza. Khetha izindlela zakho, zamukele ukulungisa okwakho.
about.value3Desc: Yakhelwe eNingizimu Afrika emiphakathini ehlukahlukene yase-Afrika. Siyaziqonda izimo eziyingqayizivele zolimi lokuphila ezindaweni zokuhlala ezwenikazi lethu nangaphandle.
about.builtByDesc: I-Netbones Africa yinkampani yezobuchwepheshe yaseNingizimu Afrika egxile kulwazi lomphakathi. Sikholelwa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe kufanele buhlanganise abantu, hhayi bubahlukanise. Ithimba lethu linomdla wokwakha amathuluzi enza ukuphila kwezindawo zokuhlala kube ngcono kuwo wonke umuntu — abahlali, abaphathi, kanye nabasebenzi.
about.ctaDesc: Qala isilingo sakho samahhala sezinsuku ezingu-14 futhi ubone ukuthi umphakathi oxhunyiwe unjani.

cta.title: Ikompleks Yakho, Exhunyiwe
cta.description: Joyina amawaka amaphakathi aguqula indlela abamelwane baxhumana ngayo, benxibelelana, futhi baphumelela. I-NetComplex iyenza kube lula ukwakha umphakathi onesibindi esixhunyiwe.

featuresPage.heroSubtitle: Qhathanisa izici kumazinga ethu amathathu futhi uthole uhlelo olulungile lomphakathi wakho.

cta.title: Usulungele Ukuqala?
cta.subtitle: Qala isilingo sakho samahhala sezinsuku ezingu-14. Akukho khadi lesikweletu elidingekayo.

pricingPage.heroSubtitle: Amazinga amathathu aklanyelwe ukuhlangabeza umphakathi wakho lapho ukhona — futhi ukhule nawe. Wonke amapulani afaka isilingo samahhala sezinsuku ezingu-14.

faqs.a1: Yebo, ungathuthukisa noma wehlise ipulani yakho nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Izinguquko ziqala ukusebenza ekuqaleni komjikelezo wakho olandelayo wokukhokha.
faqs.a2: Yebo! Wonke amapulani eza nesilingo samahhala sezinsuku ezingu-14. Akukho khadi lesikweletu elidingekayo ukuze uqale.
faqs.a3: Samukela wonke amakhadi amakhulu okuthenga kanye nokudluliswa kwebhange kumapulani wonyaka.
faqs.a4: Sinikeza isiqiniseko sokubuyisela imali sezinsuku ezingama-30. Uma ungenelisekile, xhumana nathi ukuze uthole imbuyiselo ephelele.

pricingPage.ctaDescription: Ithimba lethu lilapha ukukusiza uthole ipulani efanele umphakathi wakho.
